summary: Q1 revise-propose resolved both 117 Blocking Findings. The Bootstrap legacy requirement now contains an explicit parser-recognized MUST and the Change delta passes strict OpenSpec validation. The artifact reference model now uses stable active-canonical logical refs plus one shared archive-aware physical resolver for all non-Run Change artifacts, so existing producedResultRefs and review-apply verificationSummaryRef remain content-hash verifiable after normal OpenSpec archive relocation without rewriting terminal Runs.

resolvedFindings.evidence: The ADDED Bootstrap legacy metadata-correction Requirement body now starts with an explicit `Flowkit MUST ...` constraint. Offline OpenSpec 1.7.0 strict validation reports `Change 'execution-model-correction' is valid`.

Proposal/design/C1 delta/tasks now define a shared archive-aware resolver: persisted non-Run artifact refs keep the active canonical logical identity; before archive they resolve to the active path, after archive they resolve to exactly one `<YYYY-MM-DD>-<changeId>` archive directory. Ambiguity and content changes fail closed. The rule covers both verificationSummaryRef and producedResultRefs, and includes post-archive Reader tests.
